name: Rosemary
hook: Rosemary dying indoors? It's usually too much water.

steps.title: Full sun, 6+ hours
steps.tip: Give it your sunniest window or balcony spot. It is a sun-loving Mediterranean shrub.

steps.title: Let it dry between drinks
steps.tip: Water when the soil dries out, and never let it sit in soggy soil. Overwatering is the top killer.

steps.title: Gritty soil, 30 cm pot
steps.tip: Use a pot at least 30 cm wide and deep with drainage holes. Fill it with potting soil mixed with grit.

steps.title: Trim after it flowers
steps.tip: Trim lightly each year after flowering, but never into old, bare wood. Soft new tips taste best.

steps.title: Shelter pots in winter
steps.tip: Pots feel the cold more than plants in the ground. Wrap the pot or move it to a porch, out of winter rain.

steps.title: Indoors, check for pests
steps.tip: Indoors, watch for aphids, mealybugs, whiteflies and spider mites, and give it good airflow.

outro: Sun, fast drainage and little water: fresh sprigs all year.

sources.title: NC State Plant Toolbox: Salvia rosmarinus

faqs.question: Can I keep rosemary indoors over winter?
faqs.answer: You can, but it is tricky. Give it the sunniest spot, let the soil dry between waterings, and check often for aphids, mealybugs, whiteflies and spider mites.
